title: Morvessa's Salt-Tithe Ledgers
body: Brass-bound account books carried by High Quartermaster Morvessa during the border foreclosures (see cdx-salt-tithe). Every sack of grain, iron ingot, and burned parish was tallied against Thornwick's mining arrears—treating refugees as depreciated livestock.
unlock_hint: Inspect the brass abacus after m11.

title: Wardens of the Anchor Seals
body: An ancient order of meteor-clad sentinels bound to the Obsidian Dais (see cdx-obsidian-dais) under First Warden Ashkarath. For ten reigns they choked off the caldera's warmth to keep the primordial ember from escaping—starving northern harvests in the process.

title: Garrick's Border Picket
body: The surviving core of Thornwick's provincial levy (see cdx-thornwick-levy), held together by Sergeant-at-Arms Garrick's splinted arm and mud-stained muster rolls. Paid in worthless scrip, they held Sunken Ford and Alder Bridge on sheer stubbornness.
unlock_hint: Hold the line with Garrick in Act I.
